UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Lists', 'joomlaguide-lists', '

In this tour you fill the two empty sub-headings of Our Services, What\'s Included and Getting Started, with a bulleted and a numbered list.

You turn text into a list, type a list directly, switch between bullets and numbers, and nest sub-items.

This tour follows the tutorial 3.3 Lists of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 3.3 Lists', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Open Our Services', '

Click Our Services to open it for editing.

', 3, 'right', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Type the items as paragraphs', '

One way to make a list: type the items as paragraphs first.

  1. Click at the end of the heading What\'s Included and press Enter.
  2. Type these three lines, each followed by Enter (not after the last one):
    Roadmapping
    Technology audit
    Vendor selection support

Then click Next.

', 4, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Turn them into a bulleted list', '
  1. Select the three lines.
  2. Click the Bullet list icon in the toolbar (the one with the dots).

The three paragraphs become a bulleted list. Click Next.

', 5, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Type a numbered list', '

You can also start a list first and type straight into it.

  1. Click at the end of the heading Getting Started and press Enter.
  2. Click the Numbered list icon (the one with the numbers). The empty line becomes item 1.
  3. Type Kickoff call, press Enter, type Environment setup, press Enter, and type First milestone review.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Leave the list', '

Press Enter twice. The second Enter ends the list and gives you a normal paragraph.

Type:

After that, we settle into a regular rhythm of delivery and check-ins.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Switch the list type', '
  1. Select the three items of the Getting Started list.
  2. Click Bullet list: the numbers become bullets.
  3. Click Numbered list: the numbers are back. Keep it like this: these are steps, so numbers fit better.

Then click Next.

', 8, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Add sub-items', '
  1. Click at the end of Environment setup and press Enter.
  2. Type Provision hosting, press Enter, and type Configure DNS.
  3. Select these two lines and click the Increase indent icon (or press Tab).

The two lines are now nested under Environment setup, and the main list is numbered again. Click Next.

', 9, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Bullets under numbers', '

With the two sub-items still selected, click Bullet list.

The sub-items get bullets; the steps around them stay numbered.

Tip: the small arrow next to Numbered list offers other styles, such as letters or Roman numerals. If you try one, set the list back to numbers afterwards.

Then click Next.

', 10, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-lists'), 'Well done!', '

Our Services now has a bulleted list under What\'s Included and a numbered list with nested sub-items under Getting Started.

In the next tutorial, Links, you add a link to it.

', 12, 'top', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
